title: G6 Bg Readings "stuck"
body:
Brand new to xDrip - this has to be user error...

Finally have xDrip connected to and collecting data from Dexcom G6 sensor but the displayed value never changes.  Calibrated values are holding at 143... for hours.  After a little digging, I did notice that the raw data as reported in the Bg Readings Table have changed a little but the raw data being reported is so small and the changes are so small, the mg/dl doesn't change.

Raw data values have ranged from 2.74 to 4.3 - is that a normal range?  mg/dl has been at 143 +/- 1 and, during an overnight test, held there for 8 hours.  During the same overnight test, the Dexcom receiver DID update values to what seemed reasonable numbers.

I did do double calibration when prompted
I have deleted device and repaired multiple times - all with the same result
Have tried with BT disabled on phone running Dexcom app and Dexcom receiver off
Running 2018.05.30 codebase on Samsumg Galaxy Tab A (SM-T280), Android 5.1.1

Any help is greatly appreciated!  Thanks in advance!

comments.body: I assume you're not using either the Alpha or Nightly channel versions. First go to Update Settings in xDrip settings and select the Alpha channel and update to that version. Then on the xDrip home screen long press on the xDrip drop logo and enable the source wizard. Then use the source wizard to configure for G6. You will probably need to stop/start sensor as well.

@briandlucas Has this problem been addressed?  if yes, would you please close this issue?
Thanks
